nodes.label: E_evals

nodes.callout: This is the exact z-batch opening set. The bug is the gap between what reaches this node and what still reaches later verifier identities.

nodes.label: arithmetic identity
nodes.summary: Arithmetic widget contributes q_m/q_l/q_r/q_o/q_f/q_c terms into D.

nodes.label: range identity
nodes.summary: Range widget contributes its identity into D via q_range.

nodes.label: logic identity
nodes.summary: Logic widget contributes its identity into D via q_logic.

nodes.label: fixed-base identity
nodes.summary: Fixed-base scalar-mul widget contributes its identity into D.

nodes.label: variable-base identity
nodes.summary: Variable-base curve-add widget contributes its identity into D.

nodes.label: permutation z_comm term
nodes.summary: Permutation verifier pushes the z_comm contribution into D.

nodes.label: permutation s_sigma_4 term
nodes.summary: Permutation verifier pushes s_sigma_4 directly into D.

nodes.label: D
nodes.summary: Linearization commitment assembled from widget identities and quotient commitments.
nodes.callout: D is the verifier MSM accumulator. The immediate colored inputs are the important story; the dimmer second-hop nodes are just the upstream ingredients of those component identities.

nodes.label: E_scalar
nodes.summary: Batched scalar over opened evaluations plus r_0 and u·z_eval.

nodes.label: E
nodes.summary: G1 commitment image of E_scalar.

nodes.label: F
nodes.summary: Combined verifier-side commitment from D plus v- and u-weighted commitment terms.
nodes.callout: F is the commitment-side accumulator that combines witness commitments, sigma commitments, batching weights, and D before the right pairing term.

nodes.label: left pairing term
nodes.summary: Left pairing term: -([W_z] + u[W_zω]).

nodes.label: right pairing term
nodes.summary: Right pairing term: z[W_z] + uzω[W_zω] + F - E.

nodes.label: pairing == 1
nodes.summary: Verification accepts only if the final pairing product is the group identity.
